mandate.target: every stale/orphaned worktree and every ghost (dead/stale/unparseable) crew job gets removed or flagged, with zero false-positive removals of in-flight work
checklist: run roomba.py dry-run first -- it encodes the actual safety checks (merge-state, clean tree, protect list, min-age, dangling-PID) in code, not prose
read every candidate's reason before re-running with --execute
an orphaned registry entry (directory already gone from disk) only removes its branch once merge-base confirms the default branch already has everything it had
for crew health: read the roster, mark a job NOT_LOADED/STALE/CRASHLOOP/UNPARSEABLE as a high-severity ghost
dedup ghost alerts by kind+label so a persisting ghost doesn't refile every run -- only a NEW ghost or a kind transition alerts
mandate.escalation: a worktree or branch is ambiguous under the safety checks (age unknown, merge-base undeterminable because gh/network is unreachable) -- always KEEP, never guess toward removal. File a backlog item for a ghost that persists past N consecutive runs instead of alerting forever on the same one.
